page.layout: One page of text, with two round portrait medallions at the top centre above the text (no columns). Running head at top centre above the text. Page number at top right. Main text in one column, a paragraph on Cicero, then a second paragraph on L. Munatius Plancus. No margin notes.

main_text.l: [illegible, ~6 letters] (medallions: M. TVLLI[?]VS CICERO and LVTIVS MVNATIVS PLANCVS; the medallion portraits are pictures, not text)
CICERO, Ro.oratorum facilè princeps, obscuro satis lo-
co natus, ingenio atq; eloquentia nobilè se præstitit. honorum
desiderio forensibus causis se obtulit: in pronunciado primùm
laborauit, sicut & Demosthenes: in iocando nimius, plerosque
acriter offendit. Difficilem Roscij causam cum laude sustinuit:
vnde & odiũ Syllæ conflauit: cui cedens in Græciã abiit: philo-
sophos ac oratores Athenis audiuit. Vim opum parua licet, sed
sumptibus suis cum satis concinnam haberet, admirationi est
habitus, quòd neque mercedes, neque nummorum quicquam
in actionibus forensibus caperet. Catilinæ conatibus tam dili-
genter ac prudẽter obstitit, vt primus pater patriæ diceretur. In P.
Clodium testis fuit. Ab eodem Clodio Tribuno plebis aqua &
igni interdictus est, ac in exilium actus: vnde post aliquot mẽses
cum omnium plausu, atq; etiã laudibus ornatus, rediit Proconsul,
in Ciliciam exercitum 12000. peditum, 2600. equitum traiecit:
munera à Regibus sibi oblata renuit. Tandem cum Cæsari ad-
uersus M. Antonium fauisset, ab hoc Antonio miserè côtruci-
dari iubetur, anno mundi 3922. ante Christũ natum 40. Plutar.
in Cice. Cæsarem post Pharsalicam victoriam pertimescebat
(Pompeianarũ fiquidẽ partium fuerat) Cicero, attamen Cæsar
illi occurrens, eum præsalutauit, atque in honore habuit.
L. MVNATIVS Plancus Romæ Consul fuit eodẽ anno
quo Cicero interfectus est. Is dum Galliã Comatã regit, Lug-
dunum condit, aut (vt alij volunt) instaurat: item Rauricam, quæ
nunc est Basilea. Huius sententia. Octauio Augusto, Augusti co-
gnomen inditum est, cum alij Romulum potius dici cêserent.
Sueto.in Aug. Volater.li.18.

page.notes: Medallion captions are printed in the images: left "M. TVLLI[VS] CICERO" (letters partly cut off by the circle), right "L[VC]IVS MVNATIVS PLANCVS". Printed word "Proconsul" is as printed in the scan ("Procōsul"). The first heading line reads as a running paragraph in the scan; it is set in capitals only for "CICERO" and is given as a level-2 head above the text block. Possible misreadings: "Ro.oratorum", "Syllæ", "Plutar.", and the "[?]" marks were not needed beyond these. "Pompeianarũ fiquidẽ" as printed.
